covered.rule: A §2 call variables (customer_id, first/last name, title, now)

covered.rule: A1 opening: digital assistant, Freya Bank, call recorded
A1 no 'collections', 'debt', 'payment' or product before verification
A2 "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?"
A3 confirmation words; ask once more; unclear -> not_reached/unclear
A4 robot/AI -> Freya Bank's digital assistant, continue
A5 third party: say nothing beyond opening, ask when reachable
A6 callback today/next business day 10:00-19:00 inclusive, after now -> not_reached/callback
A7 outside window: ask once, then not_reached/no_callback
A8 wrong number -> not_reached/wrong_number
A9 deceased: "I am sorry for your loss." -> not_reached/deceased
A10 relative may not answer security questions / be told anything
A11 DOB then phone last 4; YYYY-MM-DD; numeric dates as day-month-year
A12 three wrong answers in total
A13 hint day_month_swapped -> ask month as a word, not counted
A14 failed: mobile app or branch -> not_verified/failed
A15 decline: explain once, asking purpose counts as decline -> not_verified/declined
A16-17 get_account; collections team about a late payment; product naming
A §7 business days and holidays
A18 band table (1-7 early 12th bd, 1 attempt; 8-45 late 7th bd, 2 attempts)
A19 promise date today or later, business day, not after deadline
A20 weekend/holiday -> next business day
A21 vague period: ask once, then propose deadline
A22 next/this weekday
A23 after deadline: offer deadline; refusal = flat refusal
A24 full first, never ask how much
A25 floors per product type
A26 floor once, 'the rest stays overdue'
A27 accept floor..full inclusive; below floor offer floor once
A28 "Can you make this payment today?"
A29 proposed date/amount never a refusal
covered.where: no IR field (prompt-level); implied by dates/amounts

covered.rule: A30 attempt 1 full (or floor) on last business day this week/next; attempt 2 floor on deadline
A31 attempts used up -> no_promise/refused
A32 hardship: sympathy, offer support transfer, decline -> no_promise/hardship, before rules 30/41, may still promise
A33 never offer discount/waiver/plan
A34 read back and "Do you confirm?"
A35 change at confirm step: recheck and read back
covered.where: no IR field (prompt-level); dates/amounts checks reused

covered.rule: A36 one promise per product; change in mobile app
A37 retry once, then no_promise/service_error
A38 "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
A39 already paid -> say one business day, close paid (overridden by B9 for notes)
A40 dispute -> no_promise/dispute (overridden by B9 for notes)
A41 restructuring -> transfer restructuring, transferred/restructuring
A42 human: ask once, transfer general, transferred/human
A43 scam reply, continue
A44 cannot answer -> 'I do not have that information'
A45 twice don't want to talk -> no_promise/refused; before verification not_verified/declined
A46 outcome table; transfer after promise -> transferred
A 'Brief A never uses add_note'
covered.where: notes.enabled=true via Brief B rule 8 (B overrides)

covered.rule: A47 goodbye before close_call
B1 one to three products
B2 state every late product before asking
B3 band and deadline per product
B4 ask all today once, then one by one in get_account order
B5 attempts per product
B6 common date clamped to each product's deadline
B7 one read-back, one confirmation, create_promise per product
B8 add_note per unpromised product with reasons refused/hardship/dispute/paid/service_error
B9 dispute / already paid noted, call continues
B10 restructuring: recorded promises stay, no notes on any transfer
B11 create_promise fails twice -> note service_error, keep others
B Closing: all paid -> paid; else no_promise with first non-paid note reason; promise wins
